message.content:
We are in the move dialog, currently in the "Downloads" folder. To reach the "sdk_gphone64_x86_64" storage area and then the "project_medium" folder, we should first open the "Show roots" menu to navigate to the root directory and access the desired storage area. The "Show roots" button is at [68, 79, 191, 129].


do(action="Tap", element=[68,79])
